title: I was going to say "I have zero coding background" for the algorithm, but unfortunately, I do 😅 Here is a scene I've been working on!
author: Live-Head2724
selftext:
Hey everyone,

I’ve been building this scene over the last few days and wanted to share a quick preview with you all.

Here is the stack I used to put this together:

* **Visuals & Framework:** Three.js (R3F), Blender, and Mixamo
* **Logic & AI:** MCP, Claude Opus 5.5, and Fable 5.2
* **Audio:** ElevenLabs

*Note: The character voices in this clip are currently in Turkish, but I will be adding full English translations and voiceovers very soon!*

I’m planning to share more scenes and updates as development continues. I'd love to hear your feedback or answer any questions about the workflow!
